Lake Michigan looking magnificent
in spite of the storm coming

Lake Michigan is always stunning - a study in gray today
There’s a twist. I’m originally from Toledo, OH a swamp right off Lake Erie. It’s gray for several months . I now live in Denver and winter is beautiful ! Location matters.
the lake was very gray today, i wish sarah plain and tall had gotten to see the great lakes
Today’s lake, just after some light rain passed through.

In the grayness of a Lake Superior winter, color takes on a new dimension. Snow and ice absorb and return the atmosphere around them. Light skims the surface, never staying long.
Gray and rainy this morning here on the shores of Lake Huron!
This is a storm coming in over lake Michigan. Love watching the sky and all of nature's force and beauty
We have dark gray here, kind of weird. But Lake effect snow bands are starting to stream across Lake Superior now. Bom dia FID!
I love Lake Michigan in a incoming storm So grey and choppy
Gray day. Here is a sunrise. Lake Superior
brace yourself for THE SUMMER OF NATURE SPAM. this is from the pinery. was having a little swim when a thunderstorm rolled in over lake huron. youtube.com/shorts/IaU6f...
Threatening skies are certainly more interesting and colorful. I like watching storms coming across a desert or across Lake Michigan. I especially like them if the storms are small squalls.
Another gray day here on the shores of Lake Huron befitting my mood.
A windy, wavy day on Lake Huron. I love all of the different blue tints.

Ellie and Maddie had fun at Lake Ontario today despite a little bit of rain.
We live in a Lake Michigan microclimate with lake effect clouds and snow. I've only been to Germany once but was shocked to find fall skies as grey and gloomy as home.

That happens here on the West side of Lake Michigan. We’ve had lake effect rain already, this season. Gray for days and weeks in the winter.
Currently 55 here in Benzie County. Somewhat grey. But hope for sunshine and bit more warmth as the day goes on. Last night, mouth of the Platte River, Lake Michigan.
The stark light gray reflection off Lake Michigan is doing a number on the white balance... not sure that's all of the issue, but it's surely not helping.
In Ohio - went to see Lake Erie it was wonderfully bluish gray, with lovely brisk lake air for our walk.
I know! I live in the ENTIRELY wrong ecosystem! The great gray wall of a Lake Erie winter is NOT for me!
Another gray monotone day here on the shores of Lake Huron so here is an image from a year ago .
Great Lakes gray! Same as from my house.
yeah but al least there is the sun, to the east of the great lakes it is permi grey all winter.
Mornings on the Great Lakes have been nothing but grey lately
It is, indeed. We're in Indiana, within the Great Lakes weather area. Even remembering my early childhood in Chicago, I grossly under-estimated how horribly, unendingly gray winters are here.
As someone from Buffalo, I know the pain of the Great Lakes Grey Funk every time something interesting happens.
I've spent the majority of my life near the Great Lakes (grew up in Buffalo; coming up on 18 years in Michigan), so I'm pretty comfortable with gray skies.
there is a reason i am starting to think living in a great lakes city with so much snow and grey is bad for me.
Is that recent?? So green and otherwise colorful. Mostly grey now on the shores of the Great Lakes.
